stats.title: 7 Habits That Make You Instantly Classy

structure.what_is_said: Question 'What truly makes a woman classy?' -> it is not money, status or birth; elegance is created through small habits; any woman can have a timeless, magnetic presence; the habits are simple but life-changing.
structure.how_it_is_shown: 0:00-0:07 FULL classic film (3 shots, cuts); 0:07-0:15 FULL creator in black hat (4 shots, dissolves); 0:15-0:21 FULL get-ready creator clips (vanity, bathroom, window); 0:22-0:31 WHITE + centred vertical street reel.

structure.what_is_said: 'In today's video, I'm sharing seven habits of classy and elegant women, so you can start embodying that same energy in your own life. So, let's get started, everyone.'

structure.what_is_said: First impressions: posture, presence, outfit, energy send a message you choose; grooming shows self-respect; effort in your outfit speaks volumes; be intentional, not glamorous; a personal baseline of care; consistency over perfection.

structure.what_is_said: Stay grounded when someone shakes you; don't match disrespect, redirect it; choose presence over impulse; four scripted alternatives to conflict (snapping back, over-explaining, absorbing rudeness, arguing to be right); boundaries wrapped in grace.

structure.what_is_said: 'The next habit of elegant women is dressing with intention.'
structure.how_it_is_shown: Dip through dark grey to WHITE card '3. Dressing with Intention'.

structure.what_is_said: Balance, polish, knowing what works for you; no huge wardrobe needed; rule 'reveal with refinement' (skin on top -> modest bottom; fitted -> softer); harmony keeps style timeless; well-dressed women know what flatters them.
structure.how_it_is_shown: CARAMEL+centre closet reel with inset side panels -> 2 framed panels on caramel showing the rule -> FULL creator (white room) -> WHITE + vertical reels (statue, before/after 'Me before' / 'Vs. after' with outfit changes and 2 inset panels of curvy women).

structure.what_is_said: 'If you'd like to discover what flatters you most and always have a timeless style guide to browse from, we've linked our personal stylist guide in the description. It will be sent instantly to your email after accessing.'
structure.how_it_is_shown: Starts over the before/after reel; 4:22-4:25 plain white with caption only; 4:26-4:32 FULL luxe clip (woman in cream tweed with a glass) with 'Check the description' + 'Personal Stylist Guide' script overlay.

structure.what_is_said: 'The power of mystery. The most elegant women don't put their whole lives on display.'
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card '4. The Power of Mystery', exits by dark-grey dip.

structure.what_is_said: Leave things unsaid; mystery feels rare; discretion = choosing who hears your struggles; share with intention; elegance is knowing when to speak and when to hold back.
structure.how_it_is_shown: FULL reading woman -> CARAMEL+centre series of 6 vertical clips of one Instagram creator (handle visible) -> CARAMEL+centre with insets -> WHITE + vertical styling reel held ~11.5 s -> plain white with caption.

structure.what_is_said: 'Attract, don't chase. Have you ever left a conversation feeling drained or said yes'
structure.how_it_is_shown: Grey dip -> WHITE card '5. Attract, Don't Chase'.

structure.what_is_said: We over-give and chase approval and end up empty; an elegant woman trusts her presence is enough; warm but protects her energy; a gentle no; in dating, friendships and relationships the right people won't make you chase.
structure.how_it_is_shown: FULL terrace -> ROW 3 (incl. interview still) -> FULL woman on bed -> FULL classic film (2 shots) -> rounded-frame vertical of a grey-haired woman -> FULL royal event footage -> ROW 3 -> WHITE + rounded film clip -> rounded frame film (dating, 2 shots) -> FULL friends -> CARAMEL + 2 framed photos.

structure.what_is_said: 'Confidence isn't about being the loudest voice in the room.'
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card '6. Quiet Confidence'.

structure.what_is_said: Quiet confidence turns heads without trying; she doesn't rush to prove herself; practise through body language: speak slowly, hold eye contact, don't fill every silence, walk in standing tall; less performing, more trusting yourself.
structure.how_it_is_shown: CARAMEL+centre creator -> FULL interview (Amal Clooney-like) -> FULL royal address (Kate-like) ~10 s -> CARAMEL+centre -> ROW 3 -> FULL royal event -> FULL film close-ups (Audrey-like, Jolie-like) -> ROW 3 built one by one -> CREAM + centre -> FULL YouTuber (2 shots).

structure.what_is_said: 'Elegance is never mean. Mean girl energy is the fastest way to ruin elegance.'
structure.how_it_is_shown: WHITE card '7. Elegance is Never Mean'.

structure.what_is_said: Snide comments, belittling or entitlement reveal insecurity; she doesn't try to look superior; treats everyone well from her best friend to the person serving her coffee; never dims someone else's light.
structure.how_it_is_shown: Rounded-frame film (Devil Wears Prada-like, 3 shots, hard cuts) -> FULL two women in hats -> CARAMEL+centre closet reels (3) -> ROW 3 -> FULL night toast / couple / candle shots.
